entry.title: LoRDO at ICML 2026
entry.summary: LoRDO is presented at the International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML) in Seoul. It combines low-rank optimization with infrequent communication to make distributed model training more practical on heterogeneous compute and bandwidth-limited networks.

entry.title: Cambridge joins the SOFAIR Lab
entry.summary: The Science of Fundamental AI Research (SOFAIR) Lab has launched, led by David Barber at UCL in partnership with Cambridge, Oxford and Edinburgh. Led by Nicholas Lane, our work at Cambridge will develop scalable training methods for frontier AI models across wide-area networks of heterogeneous compute, building on Flower Labs’ open-source tools.

entry.title: MT-DAO and DES-LOC at ICLR 2026
entry.content:
• MT-DAO: Multi-Timescale Distributed Adaptive Optimizers with Local Updates
  • DES-LOC: Desynced Low Communication Adaptive Optimizers for Foundation Models
entry.summary: MT-DAO and DES-LOC appear at the International Conference on Learning Representations (ICLR) in Rio de Janeiro. Both advance distributed training of large models by reducing communication between workers while retaining the benefits of adaptive optimization.
